svg.title: KuaiFlow Week 3 DeepFM plus MMoE workflow
svg.desc: Six illustrated offline stages lead into a five-step candidate-ranking path that reorders, but does not replace, the Week 2 top 100.
svg.text: KuaiFlow Week 3 — DeepFM + MMoE Multi-Task Ranking
One measured path from chronological logs to a multi-objective top-100 order
First measured logs → retrieval → multi-task ranking → final list
DeepFM + MMoE scores 1M rows across validation and test
